# Upstream 922a9f046c4a2714edf2b76fec3d1862dcd56ae3:
# command.py:6500-6533 keeps queue JSON on stdout, and exposes finished jobs.
# Go wraps jobs in protobuf JSON and adds explicit snapshot pagination.
taskfile success.json success
skygo --json run -f success.json --request-id one --wait
job-id FIRST
skygo --json run -f success.json --request-id two --wait
job-id SECOND
skygo --json jobs list --page-size 1
stdout '"id": *"'$FIRST'"'
! stdout '"id": *"'$SECOND'"'
! stderr .
page-token NEXT
skygo --json run -f success.json --request-id later --wait
job-id LATER
skygo --json jobs list --page-size 1 --page-token $NEXT
stdout '"id": *"'$SECOND'"'
! stdout '"id": *"'$FIRST'"'
! stdout '"id": *"'$LATER'"'
! stdout '"next_page_token"'
skygo --json jobs list
stdout '"id": *"'$LATER'"'
! stderr .
! skygo jobs list --page-size 201
stderr 'invalid_argument'
! stdout .
! skygo jobs list --page-token malformed
stderr 'invalid_argument'
! stdout .

# Authentication is a Go transport contract. A rejected request must never
# produce success-shaped JSON or cancel an existing job.
! skygo --token wrong --json jobs list
stderr 'unauthenticated'
! stdout .
! skygo --token wrong --json jobs get $FIRST
stderr 'unauthenticated'
! stdout .
! skygo --token wrong jobs cancel $FIRST --yes
stderr 'unauthenticated'
! stdout .
skygo --json jobs get $FIRST
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'
! stdout '"cancel_requested": *true'
! stderr .
